online.intro: One-to-one video lessons with a Costa Rican teacher. He is based in Switzerland, so there are slots that work for both Europe and the Americas.
online.paso1Texto: Times are shown in your own zone and in Costa Rica's, so there are no surprises.
online.paso2Texto: With a PayPal deposit. You settle the rest directly with your teacher.
online.paso3Texto: You get the video call link. Lessons are conversation from day one, not exercise filler.
online.profesorTexto: A Costa Rican living in Switzerland. He teaches the Spanish actually spoken in Costa Rica: the voseo, the slang and the tone, not just textbook grammar.

presencial.intro: Learning a language where it is spoken is what makes it stick.
presencial.texto: The idea is simple: the lesson leaves the classroom. You talk while walking through the national park, ordering at a soda, or asking the time at the corner shop. Vocabulary learned that way does not fade, because you used it the same day.
